description: CPI-U all items, U.S. city average, not seasonally adjusted, 1982-84=100, monthly
publisher: U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics via FRED (Federal Reserve Bank of St. Louis)
method: data/boone_county_il/reference/cpi_u_monthly.csv (fetch_reference.py); fiscal-year value = mean of the months December of the year before .. November; the base is the FY2025 mean; FY2025 has 11 months because the source has no October 2025 value, flagged missing_month; a year not yet over (FY2026, FY2027) is provisional

description: Annual estimate of the resident population of Boone County, Illinois, July 1, 2010-2019 (vintage 2019) and 2020-2025 (vintage 2025)
publisher: U.S. Census Bureau Population Estimates Program
terms: public data; cite U.S. Census Bureau
method: data/boone_county_il/reference/population_estimates.csv (fetch_reference.py); fiscal year N (December N-1 to November N) uses the July 1 estimate of year N, which falls inside it; the newest estimate is carried forward when the next is not yet published; the vintages are not spliced. The county government's population is the county's: the City of Belvidere and the other municipalities are inside it

description: Assessed valuation of Boone County by tax (levy) year; tax year L is collected in fiscal year L+1
publisher: Boone County annual audits (Property Tax Levies and Collections) and the FY2026 budget (estimate for tax year 2025)
method: data/boone_county_il/property_tax_levies.csv (section assessed_valuation; every audit that prints a tax year agrees); tax year 2025 is the budget's estimate (data/boone_county_il/reference/eav_budget_estimates.csv); the column is named eav_city in reference_by_fy.csv because the shared export reads that name
